[NDBG.9.1.3] DS uses DAP's base protocol as-is for session lifecycle
(`initialize`, `launch`, `configurationDone`, `restart`, `disconnect`),
execution control (`continue`, `next`, `stepIn`, `stepOut`, `stepBack`,
`reverseContinue`, `pause`), breakpoint management, stack/scope/variable
inspection, and the event stream. The adapter must refuse `attach`: there
is no running engine to attach to, and the error message says to use
`launch`. DS-specific surface that has no
DAP equivalent is delivered via custom requests and events, per the
DAP extensibility model (`customRequest`, event bodies with custom
`type` values).
